text:
oncall-bot: Pager: runtime-prod-7 reported repeated GPU OOMs and 5xxs across inference workers. severity=P1. link: https://incidents.redwood/1719000000 :rotating_light:

maria: taking initial triage. seeing p99 latency > 2.5s and OOM traces from gpu-02. tagging @jonathan for handoff.

jonathan: oncall here, grabbing it. maria can you paste the short timeline and key logs? :eyes:

maria: timeline so far:
- 1718999800: small latency bump on runtime-prod-7
- 1718999950: first OOM on gpu-02 (worker a3)
- 1719000000: pager fired (multiple workers)
- 1719000120: autoscaler attempted restart of affected pods

maria: logs (top lines):
```
2024-06-01T17:05:50Z worker-a3 ERROR allocate_tensor: failed to alloc 1.6GiB: out of memory
2024-06-01T17:06:01Z kvcache: grow_to 24GiB -> 32GiB (hosted) (evictions: 0)
2024-06-01T17:06:05Z runtime: batch_size=8 inflight=128
```

ashley: I see repeated kvcache growth calls with no evictions, might be fragmentation rather than true free memory. :thinking_face:

sre-lead: hypothesis 1: KV cache growth + batch amplification causing fragmentation and failed contiguous allocs. hypothesis 2: a specific model variant has a spuriously high peak activation (large seq) causing transient spike.

jonathan: quick mitigation options?

devops: immediate mitigations we can do in-prod without deploy:
- reduce default batch_size from 8 -> 4 (route-level override)
- force kvcache shrink on affected hosts via /admin/kvcache/shrink
- soft-evict oldest kv entries for large tenant prefixes

support-engineer: customer-impact check: initial metrics show 12 tenants had >5% 5xx in the last 10m, most saw retries succeed. no major data loss reported. reporting to CS.

customer-success: contacting the affected tenants (list attached) and opening incident emails. will update when CS hears back. :phone:

maria: applying batch_size override on runtime-prod-7 now (route default -> 4). pinging when done.

jonathan: while that ramps, can we collect per-GPU fragmentation stats and the allocator walk traces? need: nvml stats, cublas logs, and our kvcache allocation map.

ashley: pulling nvml: free/total on gpu-02: 3.8GiB free / 40GiB total but many small free chunks; allocator reports max_contiguous=1.1GiB.

maria: kvcache map snapshot (sizes): 12GiB contiguous blocks: 1, 512MiB blocks: 6, 128MiB: 10. suggests fragmentation. copy of snapshot uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident/1719000000/kvmap.json

jonathan: ok that matches fragmentation hypothesis. decision: keep batch down for now, trigger kvcache compaction + restart single worker with compaction flag. scheduling staggered worker restart to avoid full capacity loss.

devops: compaction command (dry-run):
```
POST /admin/kvcache/compact?node=worker-a3
body: {"mode":"aggressive","preserve_active_keys":true}
```

ashley: note: compaction can temporarily increase peak mem while copying. plan: compact one worker at a time, move traffic away before starting.

maria: rolling compaction started on worker-a3 at 1719000300. traffic routed to worker-a4.

support-engineer: CS reports retries reduced after 60s, some tenants saw improved latency.

jonathan: monitoring p95/p99. any regressions?

maria: p99 fell from 2.7s -> 1.1s after batch_size tweak and compaction on first worker. OOMs stopped on gpu-02.

sre-lead: tagging hypotheses and owners in-thread:
- H1 (fragmentation + kvcache growth): owner=ashley, evidence=kvmap + nvml max_contiguous, status=investigating
- H2 (model spike seq): owner=maria, evidence= request traces filtered by tenant, status=low-likelihood so far

jonathan: next immediate follow-ups:
- full kvmap capture across all affected hosts (owner=ashley)
- postmortem timeline with log links and memory histograms (owner=maria)
- consider route-level batch caps and auto-shrink policy (owner=devops)
- CS outreach and customer impact writeup (owner=customer-success)

customer-success: emailing customers and scheduling post-incident sync.

maria: uploading collected logs:
- nvml snapshots: s3://redwood-incident/1719000000/nvml/
- allocator traces: s3://redwood-incident/1719000000/alloc_traces/
- request samples: s3://redwood-incident/1719000000/req_samples/

ashley: preliminary note: compaction reduced fragmentation on worker-a3, max_contiguous increased to 8GiB after compaction and restart.

jonathan: marking incident as stabilizing. keeping P1 until all hosts compaction complete and CS confirms no remaining impact.

maria: estimated next update in 30m after full kvmap captures. adding link to interim RCA doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/1719000000/interim-rca :memo:

oncall-bot: Incident page updated: https://incidents.redwood/1719000000. responders: maria, jonathan, ashley, devops, support-engineer, customer-success. :white_check_mark:

sre-lead: good job team. postmortem owners should aim for writeup in 48h with root cause evidence and durable mitigations (auto-compact, batch caps, allocator tuning).

jonathan: agreed. closing live triage here — moving to #postmortems once draft ready. :thumbsup:
